page.title: Free QR code generator: a code that’s yours to keep · Honest Robin
page.description: Make a QR code for any link or text. Free, no sign-up, no expiry. The page checks it scans and says how small you can print it.
page.headline: A QR code that’s yours to keep.
page.lede: Free as free gets: no sign-up. The code opens your link directly, not through us, so it works for as long as your link does. We never see what you type.
page.fieldLabel: Link or text for the code
page.placeholder: Paste a link, or type anything
page.robinHello: I’m the robin. I check every code before you print it.
page.which: PNG works in every app. SVG stays sharp at any size, so it’s the better one for print.
page.imageNote: Your image is never uploaded. We’ll check that it still scans.
page.family: Part of the Honest Robin family.
page.cardAlt: A QR code on a sticker, and the words “A QR code that’s yours to keep.”
page.expiresA: No. The code holds your link itself and opens it directly, not through us. It works for as long as your link does, and it doesn’t depend on us at all.
page.sizeQ: How small can I print it?
page.sizeA: That depends on the code. A longer link makes a code with more squares, and each square needs about 0.6 mm for a phone to read it. Under the buttons, the page says the smallest size for your code. It’s never less than 2 cm (0.8 in).
page.formatA: Both hold the same code. PNG works in every app. SVG stays sharp at any size, so use it for anything you print.
page.changeQ: Can I change the link later?
page.changeA: No. The link is part of the code, so a printed code can’t change, and we can’t switch it off. If you may need to change where it leads, point it at a page on your own website, and change that page. A paid option with codes you can change after printing, and scan counts, is [on our roadmap]. The free tool stays as it is.
page.seeQ: Do you see what I type?
page.seeA: No. Your code is made on your own device, and nothing you type is sent anywhere. We count visits and what’s done on the page, such as how many codes are made, never what’s in them. [This page’s source code] is public, so anyone can check.
page.freeA: It costs us almost nothing to run: your device makes the code, not our servers. And it’s a way for people to meet Honest Robin, which also makes software for work.
